# IdeaProbe

> IdeaProbe is an open-source local AI market research and competitor analysis app for founders, indie developers and creators. It discovers related products, collects available reviews and discussions, and generates reports with source references using the user's own API keys.

## Authoritative project sources
- [Chinese documentation](https://github.com/pauline-zhang-star/IdeaProbe/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Complete Chinese setup and usage guide.
- [Chinese homepage](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/zh/): Chinese product overview.
- [English homepage](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/en/): English product overview.
- [Project homepage](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/): Product overview, installation, features and FAQ.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/pauline-zhang-star/IdeaProbe): Application source and issue tracking.
- [README](https://github.com/pauline-zhang-star/IdeaProbe/blob/main/README.md): Local setup, configuration, workflow and limits.
- [License](https://github.com/pauline-zhang-star/IdeaProbe/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT license.

## Capabilities
- Idea interpretation and editable keyword planning before research.
- Bing RSS, Tavily and Brave searched in parallel when enabled and available.
- Broader queries when product discovery is sparse, within request budgets.
- Ranked candidates; up to 10 products investigated in depth, with other candidates and selection reasons retained.
- App Store and Google Play reviews; separately counted verified discussion pages.
- OpenAI, native Anthropic Messages, official Gemini OpenAI-compatible API, and compatible Chat Completions services with JSON output.
- Chinese and English UI; local task history; JSON export and browser printing to PDF.

## Limits and costs
Software is MIT-licensed. Users pay their chosen API providers where applicable. Local tasks and keys are stored in .data; research content is sent to chosen providers. There is no hosted paid service, shared database, public live app, guaranteed full-web coverage, or guarantee of market demand. Review collection uses unofficial interfaces and may fail. Reviews are never invented; discussions are not verified purchase reviews. Other-provider real calls require the user's credentials.
